scope: Captured from an isolated owned C-Gate 3.4 daemon whose only network is a disposable project on the ephemeral Toolkit PCI simulator; synthetic monitor-mode SAL lines ('05 <source> <application> 00 <SAL> <checksum>') were written on that loopback connection. No site project, specialist hardware, Docker service, or live C-Bus network was used. Project names are replaced by PROJECT, the generated network OID in the per-packet 734 trace by <network-oid>, and timestamps by <timestamp>. Each #e# row's level is the lowest of nine EVENT e1..e9 sessions that delivered it; status rows carry no event level.

native_shape.event_row: 702 <address> - [<tag>] <name>[ <detail>] sourceUnit=N at level 8 (CBusBaseApplication.d); Identify uses the Lighting group class: 730 <address> - new level=L sourceunit=N ramptime=T at level 7
native_shape.status_row: #s# [# ]<tag> <name> <address> <values> #sourceunit=N OID=; '# ' marks device reports (Air-Conditioning reports, Security events, Trigger indicator kill/min, Access Control observations)
native_shape.per_packet_trace: every monitor packet also logs level-8 734 <network> <network-oid> C-Bus(<base64 'response: HEX processed by network.'>)
native_shape.invalid: rejected or trailing SAL bytes log level-4 824 '<reason>: HEX' rows; a truncated Clock update raised 903 'Critical Server Exception' and stopped all later monitor decoding, so it is captured last

cases.label: date_min

cases.label: date_max

cases.label: unknown_variable
